setup_details.value: dropout (rate 0.5) on all layers; L2 regularization (5·10⁻4) on first GCN layer
setup_details.quote: We choose the same dataset splits as in Yang et al. (2016) with an additional validation set of 500 labeled examples for hyperparameter optimization (dropout rate for all layers, L2 regularization factor for the first GCN layer and number of hidden units).

setup_details.value: max 200 epochs; early stopping if validation loss does not improve for 10 consecutive epochs
setup_details.quote: We train all models for a maximum of 200 epochs (training iterations) using Adam (Kingma & Ba, 2015) with a learning rate of 0.01 and early stopping with a window size of 10 , i.e. we stop training if the validation loss does not decrease for 10 consecutive epochs.
